feature: Make 256 Pixels the Default Output Size

phases.name: Update Default Size
phases.description: Change the default icon size from multiple sizes to 256 pixels only

subtasks.description: Update the --sizes argument default from [16, 32, 48, 64, 128, 256] to [256]

verification.run: python ico_converter.py --help to verify default: 256, and python ico_converter.py test.png --dry-run to verify it shows Icon sizes: 256x256

subtasks.description: Update DEFAULT_SIZES constant from [(16, 16), (32, 32), (48, 48), (64, 64), (128, 128), (256, 256)] to [(256, 256)] for consistency

verification.run: Verify the constant is updated and code still runs without errors
